subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should reaction prompt policy be derived from the existing `reactionLevel` and `reactionNotifications` controls, or should Telegram expose an independently configurable guidance mode?
rationale: Both existing settings already influence parts of the proposed behavior, so adding another defaulted config field could create overlapping policy and upgrade-visible prompt changes.

options.title: Compose Existing Controls
options.body: Keep `reactionLevel` authoritative for outbound guidance and add incoming soft-signal guidance only when `reactionNotifications` is enabled.

options.title: Add Independent Guidance Mode
options.body: Add `reactionGuidance: off|minimal|full` with explicit precedence, defaults, schema metadata, documentation, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep Transport Only
options.body: Retain current reaction events and outbound guidance without prescribing model interpretation of incoming emoji.

recommendation.title: Compose Existing Controls
recommendation.body: Keep `reactionLevel` authoritative for outbound guidance and add incoming soft-signal guidance only when `reactionNotifications` is enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent issue triage already framed the unresolved product boundary between the existing controls and a new setting.
